Svelte's OFFICIAL custom-renderer API (sveltejs/svelte#18042, `createRenderer` from `svelte/renderer`) is still an UNMERGED PR, so the adapter instead patches globalThis DOM classes so stock compiled Svelte output runs unchanged — a deliberate, accepted coupling to Svelte PRIVATE internals, to be replaced by the official API once it ships.
